transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in today?

Well, I'm here because... I have a really hard time with bridges. If I know I have to cross one, and there's no way around it, I just get this immediate, intense fear. My heart starts pounding in my chest, my hands get all sweaty gripping the steering wheel or the armrest if I'm a passenger... and it hits me before I'm even on the bridge. It's just a terrible rush of anxiety the second I realize I have to go over it.
Do you ever have sudden panic attacks when you are not facing or thinking about crossing a bridge?

No, I don't. It's really just tied to the bridges. If I'm sitting at home reading or just going about my normal day, I feel completely fine. I don't get those sudden attacks out of nowhere... it's only when a bridge is involved.
